shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a green shirt sits in the counter-side window seat telling a story, a man in an orange shirt sits in the plant-side window seat, and a man in a white shirt sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and the plant-end seat and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt and a man in an orange shirt exchange seats, and he asks about the story.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt asks another question about the story.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the counter-side window seat.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt answers the question about the story.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the rectangular table.
